# WO-2026-08-12-01-v2 — Coverage plus grounding: make the better eyesight unable to invent what it saw

## Acceptance criteria

> **v2 — amended after Keel's read-back REFUSE, which was correct on all four counts.** Changes are
> flagged **[AMENDED]**. Everything unflagged stands from v1.

**Warwick's framing, which every AC serves:** *"THE PROCESS CAN NOW SEE FAR MORE OF THE PAGE. Now make
it impossible for that better eyesight to invent what it saw."* Coverage and grounding are SEPARATE
axes: **do not weaken coverage to reduce hallucination, and do not raise hallucination tolerance to
improve recall.** *See more AND guess less.*

**AC1 — the loop runs cleanly (requirement A).** Region 1 requestable end to end. **BOTH** sides of the
split-representation defect fixed: the throwing lookup (`agenticLoop.js:240-243`) and the **silent**
`.filter(Boolean)` in the iteration-cap branch (`:230`) which drops an unavailable region with no error.
Evidence: a live run where the model requests region 1 and the loop completes, plus a test proving the
previously-silent path now fails loudly. **Do not "fix" this by ceasing to advertise region 1** — live
evidence shows a mid-loop full-page re-look is a coverage strategy the model actually uses.

**AC2 — the output space is closed (requirement B).** The final answer is constrained by strict JSON
schema on `/v1/responses` using the **FLAT** `text.format` shape `{type:'json_schema', name,
strict:true, schema}`. Every photo-derived line carries **all four**:
- `product_id` — closed enum: exactly the candidate IDs supplied for that turn, **plus mandatory
  `UNKNOWN_VISIBLE_ITEM` and `NOT_A_LINE`**.
- `as_written` — **UNCONSTRAINED free text**, verbatim, what was actually read. The only thing that
  makes a wrong-but-legal ID detectable.
- `source_region` — an integer that MUST be one supplied this turn.
- `confidence` — a number (see AC6).

**[AMENDED — F2 upheld]** `visionAgenticTurn` (`services/obsidiwikai/src/core/models.mjs:293`) builds the
entire `/responses` body and exposes no seam. **`models.mjs` is now in `file_surface`.** Add ONE optional
pass-through parameter (e.g. `textFormat`) and nothing else — no refactor, no behaviour change when the
parameter is absent, and existing callers must be unaffected. Keel's option (i) is taken: option (ii)
would duplicate the gateway client and its credential read, which this estate must not have two of.

⚠️ **Two shapes are forbidden and one fails SILENTLY.** Nested `json_schema` under `text.format` → loud
400. **`response_format` on `/responses` → HTTP 200 with NO constraint applied** — and `/responses` is
the endpoint this prototype calls. Paste the body you actually sent.

**AC3 — the two questions are asked separately (requirement B).** Visual existence — *is there a
handwritten line in this application-owned region?* — asked distinctly from product resolution — *which
supplied candidate does it correspond to?* Uncertainty is a **successful** outcome.
*Why this is not optional: with escape hatches removed the model returned a confidently WRONG in-enum ID
5/5 rather than declining, and silently returned an empty array 2/5.* **Enforcement does not create
honesty — it converts invention into confident mis-identification and silent omission, both harder to
detect than what they replace.**

**AC4 — the constraint is verified client-side, not trusted.** Every returned `product_id` validated
against the enum actually sent; mismatch **fails loudly**. A cheap guard converting a silent regression
into a visible one — not a second grounding mechanism.

**AC5 — region grounding by MEMBERSHIP (requirement C). [AMENDED — F8 upheld].** A line whose
`source_region` is not one the application supplied **cannot become PHOTO truth** — rejected, not
downgraded. **v1 wrongly said "port `checkMissingSourceRegion`": that function only asserts
`source_region != null` and does NOT perform the membership test.** Reuse it if useful, but the
membership property is **new logic, implemented in-surface**.
*Honest limitation to record, not solve: region attribution is near-degenerate in practice — 32/42 and
29/40 lines cited region 2 and ZERO cited region 1 across two runs. This is a floor, not proof.*

**AC6 — confidence triggers, never accepts.** Confidence may be used **only** to decide *"look again"*.
Never acceptance authority — *"Terra can be confidently wrong."* Do **not** port
`applyVisionConfidenceGate`: it makes confidence an acceptance authority and carries a live hazard (on
the photo path the key is always set, so a missing confidence becomes `Number(null) === 0` and demotes
every matched line).
*Correction: "restore the broken confidence wiring" describes a defect that does not exist — production
confidence works end to end; the `null` came from a diagnostic script reading a key the resolver never
emits. What is genuinely missing is that the PROTOTYPE has no confidence field at all.*

**AC7 — the quantity invariant holds (requirement C).** Direct-import `leadingQuantityEvidence`,
`checkUnjustifiedQuantity`, `checkImplausibleQuantity` from `photoSanityChecks.js` — confirmed pure over
`{raw_reading, quantity}`. **A pack-size number in a product name must NOT become purchase quantity**;
quantity survives only on leading-count or explicit-multiplier evidence, else nulled. The known
photograph carries a live instance and the prototype has already reproduced the failure.

**AC8 — duplicates surface, never vanish (requirement D). [AMENDED — F8 upheld].** Same region → one
survivor. **Different** regions → **no survivor**; all members surfaced for a human with the collided
candidate preserved. **v1 wrongly said "port `resolveCrossStripDuplicates`": it always elects a survivor
BY CONFIDENCE, which contradicts both this AC and AC6.** Reuse its grouping and normalisation; implement
the stated property in-surface.

**AC9 — a fit-for-purpose scorer, in-surface. [AMENDED — F1 upheld, Keel's option (ii) taken].**
`abAcceptanceHarness.js` sits at `services/asdair/pipeline/`, outside your surface, and is a **legacy A/B
instrument for the pre-agentic strategies**: it parses ground truth from *markdown* while the truth is
now JSON, and its fuzzy name matching cannot express identity against a closed ID enum. **Do not modify
it. Build the seven-category scorer and the 39-line loader inside `agenticVisionPrototype/`.** Report —
do not fix — that `abAcceptanceHarness.js:69` still hardcodes the forbidden 41-line trolley; **Larry owns
that follow-up.**
Seven categories, all reported: **correct PHOTO lines · omissions · inventions · wrong identity · wrong
quantity · explicit UNKNOWNs · duplicates.** An explicit `UNKNOWN_VISIBLE_ITEM` is **not** the same as a
low-confidence guess — report them separately.
*Accepted limit (F10): the 39-line truth carries `{product, qty}` and no IDs, so "wrong identity"
resolves the chosen `product_id` to its catalogue name/aka and ends in a text-similarity join. **State
that limit beside the number** — do not let a seven-way table imply ID-level truth.*

**AC10 — two live arms. [AMENDED — F6 upheld; the arms are redefined].** Keel is right that v1's arms
were degenerate: with no catalogue the enum holds only the two escapes, so every line is necessarily
UNKNOWN and "correct" is structurally zero — that cannot reproduce a baseline measured on an
unconstrained loop. **The corrected design isolates one variable per arm, against the run already on
record:**

| Arm | Constraint | Catalogue | What it isolates |
|---|---|---|---|
| *(already measured, do not re-run)* | none | none | the existing ~18% omission / ~19–25% invention baseline |
| **A** | **none** (loop as today) | **real, 109 items** | what the household catalogue alone does to coverage and invention |
| **B** | **full AC2 constraint** | **real, 109 items** | what structural grounding adds on top |

Report all seven categories for **A** and **B**, plus measured **calls, wall time and gateway cost** per
arm. Arm A answers the question nothing on record answers — **the coverage loop has never once been run
with a real catalogue** — and it is what makes Arm B's improvement attributable.

**AC11 — report the two invention mechanisms separately.** **(a)** a supplied candidate becoming a PHOTO
line with no image evidence (the `Lucozade Raspberry` class — a flavour-token substitution on a product
genuinely present, defeated by AC3); **(b)** free generation of a brand from ambiguous handwriting with
no candidate list at all (the `Nivea` class — defeated by AC2). **Do NOT special-case any product name.**
Report which dominates once both halves are present.

**Warwick's acceptance bar, quoted — the grading contract, not a target to round toward:** ~95%+
automatically correct · **ZERO invented PHOTO lines** · ZERO silent quantity guesses · ZERO household
enrichment masquerading as PHOTO · no large silent omission class. His calibration: *38 correct / 1
UNKNOWN / 0 inventions* is **SUCCESS**; *34 correct / 5 UNKNOWN / 0 inventions* **may still be
trustworthy**; *39 "answers" obtained by inventing six products* is **FAILURE**. An honest UNKNOWN costs
far less than a confident invention — that asymmetry should be visible in the code, not only the report.

⛔ **A result that misses the bar is a REPORTABLE RESULT, not a failure to hide or grind against.**
Warwick: *"If that architecture still cannot approach the trustworthiness bar, say so plainly. But do not
return to symptom-by-symptom prompt whack-a-mole."* One diagnostic correction of a genuine defect you
introduced is in scope; tuning wording until the score improves is not.

Report the new counts.

- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/asdair/pipeline/agenticVisionPrototype` → report exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass. (Your preflight: exit 0, 9 files, 0 secrets.)
